shiftLock.slot: Small cap or slot near gear selector base on center console
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
AUTOMATIC: Locate the small plastic cap near the gear selector base on the center console. Pry off with a key or thin flathead.
Insert key into the exposed slot and press firmly downward.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral. Replace cap.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral. No shift lock exists on manual.
Apply parking brake.
12V battery under the hood — connect jump pack.
Once powered, press brake and shift to N normally.
FWD: lift from rear — front (drive) wheels roll on ground. Very light vehicle — watch approach angle on ramp.

tow.method: Lift from rear (front FWD wheels roll). Flatbed optional.
notes: Very small and light — simple wheel-lift from rear.

alerts.warning: Very small vehicle — watch clearance under tow truck.
alerts.notes: Small, light vehicle. FWD — rear lift. Manual trans: depress clutch, N.

shiftLock.slot: Electronic — touchscreen or selector override near base
steps: Turn vehicle to ON/Ready mode.
Electronic selector or touchscreen — select N.
If power is lost: connect jump pack to 12V auxiliary under hood.
12V AUXILIARY ONLY — NEVER touch HV battery.
FLATBED ONLY — electric drivetrain.
12V auxiliary under hood.
12V AUXILIARY ONLY — never touch HV battery.
Once powered, select N electronically.

battery.warning: FLATBED ONLY. 12V auxiliary only — never touch HV system.

alerts.warning: FLATBED ONLY. 12V only — never touch HV system.

shiftLock.slot: Override slot near selector base under console trim
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the override slot at the selector base under the console trim.
Insert key or flathead into the slot and press firmly.
Press the brake pedal while holding.
Move the selector to N. Confirm N on the display.
Apply parking brake.
12V battery under the hood — connect jump pack.
Once powered, press brake and shift to N normally.
FWD: lift from rear — front (drive) wheels roll on ground.
AWD: FLATBED ONLY — 500X AWD has no transfer case neutral.

tow.method: FWD: lift from rear. AWD: flatbed preferred.

alerts.notes: FWD: rear lift. AWD: flatbed preferred.

steps: Turn ignition to ON.
The 500L has a 6-speed DUAL-CLUTCH TRANSMISSION (DCT) — DCT requires 12V power to shift reliably.
Locate the override slot near the selector base. Insert key and press firmly.
Press the brake pedal while holding.
Move the selector to N.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION variant: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to N. No shift lock exists.
Apply parking brake.
DCT REQUIRES POWER: 12V battery under the hood — connect jump pack.
Once powered, press brake and shift to N normally. DCT transmissions may resist without power.
FWD: lift from rear — front (drive) wheels roll on ground.
Do NOT flat-tow the 500L automatic (DCT) — no lubrication pump when engine not running.

tow.method: Lift from rear (front FWD wheels roll). Do not flat-tow DCT.

alerts.warning: DCT transmission: rear lift only, not flat-tow.
alerts.notes: FWD — rear lift. DCT: rear lift only (not flat-tow).

shiftLock.slot: Small slot near gear selector base on center console
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock release: small cap near gear selector base on center console.
Pry off cap with ignition key or small flathead screwdriver.
Insert key or thin flathead into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool and replace cap.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack — under hood, driver side.
Once powered, press brake and shift to N.
Manual: depress clutch, select Neutral.
RWD: lift from rear. High-value — flatbed preferred.

tow.method: RWD: lift from rear. Flatbed preferred.
notes: Mazda MX-5 ND platform. High-value — flatbed preferred.

alerts.notes: Mazda MX-5 (ND) platform. Manual: depress clutch. High-value roadster — flatbed preferred.
